pages.text: Inside a ring of ruined walls a $(l)stair leads down to the south$(); at its foot lies the labyrinth. There is always one not far from spawn, and guardians sell a $(l)Knossos map$().$(br2)In the centre of the entrance cell stands the $(l)thread altar$(): right-click with an empty hand for a ball of Ariadne's thread (only if you have none).

Deep inside is the $(l)bull-head gate$(): right-click it holding the thread to open it. The trial begins once you enter the hall and the gate closes behind you; right-click the gate from the hall side to retreat.$(br2)If no one is in the hall for $(l)30 seconds$() the trial resets with no reward; open the gate again to retry.
$(o)Source$(): Daedalus built the labyrinth for King Minos of Crete to hold the Minotaur (Apollodorus, $(o)Library$() 3.1.4). The layout, gate and devices are this mod's own.
